name: NKT Photonics
description: NKT Photonics is a Danish photonics company headquartered in Birkerod, manufacturing fiber lasers, photonic crystal fibers, supercontinuum sources, and single-frequency lasers used by quantum and photonics labs worldwide. The company has an explicit Quantum & Nano Technology product line — its Koheras low-noise lasers are widely deployed in cold-atom systems and as pumps for single-photon sources. NKT is the only Danish company in the European Quantum Flagship and is also a member of the European Quantum Industry Consortium, the Quantum Economic Development Consortium, and the Danish Quantum Community board.

news.title: NKT Photonics renamed Hamamatsu Photonics A/S following Hamamatsu Photonics K.K. acquisition
news.excerpt: Effective June 25, 2026, NKT Photonics A/S was renamed Hamamatsu Photonics A/S and repositioned as the Lasers & Fibers Business Unit within the Hamamatsu Photonics Group. Products and staff remain unchanged; Koheras low-noise lasers continue under the new brand.
